title: release(ci): automate artifact signing, SBOM generation, and provenance release manifests for private-installer
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Private deployment customers require verifiable release artifacts for audit and compliance. This PR adds CI automation to produce signed artifacts, Syft/CoS-enabled SBOMs, and SLSA-style provenance release manifests for private-installer releases. The goal is to make every release produce an auditable set of artifacts (tarballs, Helm charts, OCI images) with cosign signatures and SBOMs stored alongside release manifests so downstream installers and air-gapped customers can verify provenance.

What this changes (single continuous description): Adds a release workflow that builds artifacts in a reproducible way, generates SBOMs using Syft, signs artifacts with cosign (integration to the existing signing key service), and emits a release-manifests/ directory containing JSON manifest entries for each artifact (including sha256, signature references, sbom URIs, build metadata). Includes a helper script for offline verification and updates the Helm chart packaging step to include the provenance metadata label. Adds Terraform module tweak to include release-manifests bucket path in installer docs so Private customers can fetch manifests programmatically. Keeps defaults backwards-compatible; nothing in this PR changes installer runtime behavior.

Checklist:
- [x] CI workflow: .github/workflows/release-provenance.yml
- [x] Artifact signing script: scripts/sign-artifacts.sh (cosign wrapper, retries, env validation)
- [x] SBOM generation: ci/sbom/syft-wrapper.sh
- [x] Release manifest schema + generator: manifests/provenance/generate_manifest.sh
- [x] Helm chart labeling changes: charts/private-installer/Chart.yaml + templates/_helpers.tpl
- [x] Terraform docs: infra/terraform/modules/private-installer/README.md updated
- [x] Integration tests: verify-manifest.sh (runs in CI, exercised by release workflow)

Testing and verification: The release workflow was executed on a fork and on a protected test branch. I validated that tarballs and chart package uploads were signed and SBOMs were generated and that the manifest generator outputs stable fields for a given build seed. CI run: successful build on ubuntu-latest, cosign signing step stubbed in CI for public run, full signing executed in internal CI with key material. See CI summary below.

Security considerations: cosign keys are not stored in repo; workflow reads from the existing internal signing secrets. Scripts perform explicit env checks and fail fast if secrets are missing. SBOMs may contain build-time environment variables; we filter out known secrets and add guidance in README.

Rollout: This is safe to merge to main. The workflow is gated on tag pushes (release/* and v* tags). No runtime code changed. If any signing step fails, the workflow fails and no release artifacts are published.

Related: Linked Linear items and prior PRs for provenance in private-installer. See ENG-3124 for the audit requirements. Mirrors previous work in pr-4065 and pr-3698.

release_notes:
- Add CI workflow to produce signed release artifacts and SBOMs for private-installer releases.
- Emit provenance release manifests (schema_version: v1.0) alongside artifacts.
- Add helper scripts for offline verification and Terraform docs pointing to release-manifests.
- No runtime breaking changes.

Operational impact: Private customers and air-gapped installs can now fetch signed artifacts and verify provenance using the provided helper scripts.
